title: Main Sequence
statementMd:
As you know, Vova has recently become a new shaman in the city of Ultima Thule. So, he has received the shaman knowledge about the correct bracket sequences. The shamans of Ultima Thule have been using lots of different types of brackets since prehistoric times. A bracket type is a positive integer. The shamans define a correct bracket sequence as follows:

- An empty sequence is a correct bracket sequence.
- If ${*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*l*}}$ and ${*b*_{1}, *b*_{2}, ..., *b*_{*k*}}$ are correct bracket sequences, then sequence ${*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*l*}, *b*_{1}, *b*_{2}, ..., *b*_{*k*}}$ (their concatenation) also is a correct bracket sequence.
- If ${*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*l*}}$ — is a correct bracket sequence, then sequence ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/23d6a879e6e73067450bcb6f00ab4d78bc7731a6.png) also is a correct bracket sequence, where $*v*$ $(*v* > 0)$ is an integer.

For example, sequences ${1, 1,  - 1, 2,  - 2,  - 1}$ and ${3,  - 3}$ are correct bracket sequences, and ${2,  - 3}$ is not.

Moreover, after Vova became a shaman, he learned the *most important* correct bracket sequence ${*x*_{1}, *x*_{2}, ..., *x*_{*n*}}$, consisting of $*n*$ integers. As sequence $*x*$ is the most important, Vova decided to encrypt it just in case.

Encrypting consists of two sequences. The first sequence ${*p*_{1}, *p*_{2}, ..., *p*_{*n*}}$ contains types of brackets, that is, $*p*_{*i*} = |*x*_{*i*}|$ ($1 ≤ *i* ≤ *n*$). The second sequence ${*q*_{1}, *q*_{2}, ..., *q*_{*t*}}$ contains $*t*$ integers — **some positions** (possibly, not all of them), which had negative numbers in sequence ${*x*_{1}, *x*_{2}, ..., *x*_{*n*}}$.

Unfortunately, Vova forgot the main sequence. But he was lucky enough to keep the encryption: sequences ${*p*_{1}, *p*_{2}, ..., *p*_{*n*}}$ and ${*q*_{1}, *q*_{2}, ..., *q*_{*t*}}$. Help Vova restore sequence $*x*$ by the encryption. If there are multiple sequences that correspond to the encryption, restore any of them. If there are no such sequences, you should tell so.

## Input

The first line of the input contains integer $*n*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{6}$). The second line contains $*n*$ integers: $*p*_{1}, *p*_{2}, ..., *p*_{*n*}$ $(1 ≤ *p*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9})$.

The third line contains integer $*t*$ ($0 ≤ *t* ≤ *n*$), followed by $*t*$ distinct integers $*q*_{1}, *q*_{2}, ..., *q*_{*t*}$ $(1 ≤ *q*_{*i*} ≤ *n*)$.

The numbers in each line are separated by spaces.

## Output

Print a single string "`NO`" (without the quotes) if Vova is mistaken and a suitable sequence ${*x*_{1}, *x*_{2}, ..., *x*_{*n*}}$ doesn't exist.

Otherwise, in the first line print "`YES`" (without the quotes) and in the second line print $*n*$ integers $*x*_{1}, *x*_{2}, ..., *x*_{*n*}$ $(|*x*_{*i*}| = *p*_{*i*}; *x*_{*q*_{*j*}} < 0)$. If there are multiple sequences that correspond to the encrypting, you are allowed to print any of them.
statementZhMd:
众所周知，Vova 最近成为了 Ultima Thule 城的一名新萨满。因此，他学习了有关正确括号序列的萨满知识。自史前时代起，Ultima Thule 的萨满们就一直使用许多不同类型的括号。括号类型是一个正整数。萨满们按如下方式定义正确括号序列：

- 空序列是一个正确括号序列。
- 如果 ${*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*l*}}$ 和 ${*b*_{1}, *b*_{2}, ..., *b*_{*k*}}$ 是正确括号序列，那么序列 ${*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*l*}, *b*_{1}, *b*_{2}, ..., *b*_{*k*}}$（即它们的拼接）也是一个正确括号序列。
- 如果 ${*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*l*}}$ 是一个正确括号序列，那么序列 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/23d6a879e6e73067450bcb6f00ab4d78bc7731a6.png) 也是一个正确括号序列，其中 $*v*$ $(*v* > 0)$ 是一个整数。

例如，序列 ${1, 1,  - 1, 2,  - 2,  - 1}$ 和 ${3,  - 3}$ 是正确括号序列，而 ${2,  - 3}$ 不是。

此外，在成为萨满之后，Vova 学习到了*最重要的*正确括号序列 ${*x*_{1}, *x*_{2}, ..., *x*_{*n*}}$，它由 $*n*$ 个整数构成。由于序列 $*x*$ 非常重要，Vova 决定以防万一对其进行加密。

加密结果由两个序列组成。第一个序列 ${*p*_{1}, *p*_{2}, ..., *p*_{*n*}}$ 包含括号类型，即 $*p*_{*i*} = |*x*_{*i*}|$（$1 ≤ *i* ≤ *n*$）。第二个序列 ${*q*_{1}, *q*_{2}, ..., *q*_{*t*}}$ 包含 $*t*$ 个整数——序列 ${*x*_{1}, *x*_{2}, ..., *x*_{*n*}}$ 中原本为负数的*某些位置*（可能不是全部位置）。

不幸的是，Vova 忘记了原序列。不过幸运的是，他还保留着加密结果：序列 ${*p*_{1}, *p*_{2}, ..., *p*_{*n*}}$ 和 ${*q*_{1}, *q*_{2}, ..., *q*_{*t*}}$。请根据加密结果帮助 Vova 恢复序列 $*x*$。如果有多个符合加密结果的序列，恢复其中任意一个即可。如果不存在这样的序列，请说明这一点。

## 输入格式

输入第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{6}$）。第二行包含 $*n*$ 个整数：$*p*_{1}, *p*_{2}, ..., *p*_{*n*}$（$1 ≤ *p*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}$）。

第三行包含一个整数 $*t*$（$0 ≤ *t* ≤ *n*$），以及 $*t*$ 个互不相同的整数 $*q*_{1}, *q*_{2}, ..., *q*_{*t*}$（$1 ≤ *q*_{*i*} ≤ *n*$）。

每行中的数字均以空格分隔。

## 输出格式

如果 Vova 弄错了，不存在符合要求的序列 ${*x*_{1}, *x*_{2}, ..., *x*_{*n*}}$，则输出一个字符串 "`NO`"（不含引号）。

否则，第一行输出 "`YES`"（不含引号），第二行输出 $*n*$ 个整数 $*x*_{1}, *x*_{2}, ..., *x*_{*n*}$（$|*x*_{*i*}| = *p*_{*i*}; *x*_{*q*_{*j*}} < 0$）。如果有多个符合加密结果的序列，可以输出其中任意一个。
